# baffinbay_certificate (Resource)

Manages a Baffin Bay Certificate.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) The type of certificate (pem, lets_encrypt).

### Optional

- `certificate` (String, Sensitive) The PEM encoded certificate. Required for type 'pem'.
- `fqdn` (String) The FQDN for the certificate. Required for type 'lets_encrypt'.
- `intermediate` (String, Sensitive) The PEM encoded intermediate certificate. Optional for type 'pem'.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) The PEM encoded private key. Required for type 'pem'.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the certificate.
